answer: 82% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. Because the opal burn is written down at the onyx settlement, the bridge audit shows the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. A 367 account operation therefore ties up 3 million dollars of idle capital. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
